target_customer: Sales teams that need automated prospecting and lead lists
problem: Salespeople spend time finding and filtering leads; Slik offered a database of over 70 million people with filters and an automated SDR.
business_model: B2B SaaS for sales prospecting (pricing not stated in sources opened)

founders.name: Soroush Ghodsi
founders.background_notes: YC page bio. BetaKit and CNBC (2017) say he was 15 when accepted to YC; ages vary across outlets, so age_at_founding is left null.

founders.name: Stefan Stokic
founders.background_notes: YC page bio. CNBC (2017) reportedly gave his age as 16 at the time of acceptance.

technical_complexity.rationale: Aggregating and filtering a database of 70 million people plus machine learning outreach is standard data engineering with data sourcing as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: A contact database could be a data asset, but no source shows exclusive sourcing, and established data vendors operated in the same space.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: These established vendors existed in the category (current comparison pages, undated for 2017); no source shows any action against Slik.

market_need_then: The YC launch post of 2017-07-19 positioned Slik as a better, cheaper prospecting engine, but no dated source quantified demand.

branding.domain_note: Used the slik.ai domain, an AI top level domain.
branding.brand_signature: Founder story: teen founders who cold called Sam Altman and were reported as the youngest founders in YC history
branding.community_and_virality: Wide press on the founders (BetaKit, CNBC, Business Insider, Mic, 2016 to 2017), and a Product Hunt presence, but the coverage is about the founders rather than the brand.

brand_strength.rationale: The name is short and distinctive, and the founder story drew strong press, but no coverage of logo, voice or product brand was found.

outcome_analysis: Slik was a YC Summer 2017 sales prospecting company founded by two teenagers who had previously built Synapse, and it drew heavy press for their age. YC lists it as Inactive, and no funding, shutdown notice, acquisition or post-mortem was found. The cause is not public, so failure factors are left empty.
notes: The outcome search returned only software defined radio pages, so a second query was used for press; funding and cross-check searches found no round and one directory listing mentioned family office investors without names. slik.ai did not resolve from this session. The YC launch post (2017-07-19) names no competitors, so the list is empty; the vendors named in takeover risk come from undated current comparison pages and are not recorded as competitors. Education not found in sources.
